items.label: subject particle

items.label: subject particle

items.explanation: て links なく to the rest, forming the base なくて of the expression of obligation.

translation.pt-BR: Meu pai sempre fala em voz bem alta.
translation.en: My father always speaks in a very loud voice.

items.label: particle of means/manner
items.explanation: で indicates the manner in which the action is done: 大声で = 'loudly / in a loud voice', the instrument or manner of the verb 話す.

items.jp: 病気のせいで私は旅行に行けなかった。

translation.pt-BR: Não consegui viajar por causa de uma doença.
translation.en: Illness prevented me from taking a trip.

items.label: marca de causa (locução 〜のせいで)
items.explanation: で fecha a locução 〜のせいで ('por causa de'), usada quando o motivo levou a algo ruim, como perder a viagem.

items.jp: それでいい？

translation.pt-BR: Assim está bom?
translation.en: Is that okay?

items.label: indicates means/state: "with this, in this way"
items.explanation: Here で joins with それ to form それで ("with that / so"), marking the state of things as the basis on which it is asked whether it is fine.

items.jp: それで十分？

translation.pt-BR: Assim é suficiente?
translation.en: Is it enough?

items.label: indicates means/state: "with this, in this way"
items.explanation: で combines with それ forming それで ("with that"), presenting the current situation as that whose sufficiency is being questioned.

items.jp: 後で電話して！

translation.pt-BR: Me liga depois!
translation.en: Call me later.

items.label: particle forming the temporal expression 後で
items.explanation: で links to 後 to situate when the action should occur ('later'); 後で is the fixed time unit of the request.
tokens: adverb of time (head of 後で)
verbal noun (object of する in 電話する)

items.jp: 何で強がるの？

translation.pt-BR: Por que você está se fazendo de durão?
translation.en: Why are you pretending to be tough?

items.label: で forming the interrogative expression 何で
items.explanation: together with 何, this で forms 何で ('why'), asking the reason for the action.

items.jp: レストランで働いたことなど一度もない。

translation.pt-BR: Nunca na vida trabalhei em restaurante.
translation.en: I've never worked in a restaurant.

items.label: particle of place of action
items.explanation: で marca レストラン como o lugar onde o trabalho teria acontecido.

items.jp: 薬を飲んで元気になった

translation.pt-BR: Tomei o remédio e melhorei.
translation.en: I took the medicine and got better.

items.label: conjunctive (て-form)
items.explanation: で is the て-form of 飲む after a voiced syllable (飲んで); it links the action to the result, with a sense of cause ('I took it and, therefore,...').

items.jp: 食べないでいいよ。

translation.pt-BR: Não precisa comer isso, viu.
translation.en: It's OK not to eat it.

items.label: conjunctive particle forming 〜ないで ('without doing / not doing')
items.explanation: Here で links the negative form 食べない to the rest, creating 食べないで = 'without eating'. It is the marker of the grammatical target 〜ないで.

items.jp: どの新聞を読んでも話は同じだろう。

translation.pt-BR: Não importa qual jornal você leia, a história deve ser a mesma.
translation.en: Any paper you read will tell the same story.

items.label: connective particle (て form)
items.explanation: で here is the voiced -te form of 読む (読んで); it links the verb to も to construct 'even reading / no matter which one reads'.

items.jp: 父が死んで十年になる。

translation.pt-BR: Faz dez anos que meu pai morreu.
translation.en: It is ten years since my father died.

items.label: conjunctive particle (te-form)
items.explanation: で here is the marker of the て form of 死ぬ (死ん+で, because verbs in ぬ use で). It links the clause 'my father died' to the following clause, giving the sense of 'since (he) died'.

items.jp: みんなもそうなのかな、と思うことくらいしかできない。

translation.pt-BR: A única coisa que consigo fazer é ficar me perguntando se é assim para todo mundo.
translation.en: I can only wonder if this is the same for everyone else.

items.label: nominalizador da pergunta (bloco のか)
items.explanation: Este の empacota そうな em um bloco nominal e prepara a pergunta que vem logo em seguida com か.
tokens: substantivo que transforma a ação em um nome

items.jp: この花はきれいな色だね

translation.pt-BR: Essa flor tem uma cor bonita, né?
translation.en: This flower has a beautiful color, doesn't it?

items.label: topic particle
items.explanation: は presents 花 as the topic of the sentence: 'as for this flower...'.
